qa_pairs.instruction: Why would you need to set up one-way synchronization in the Delimited Text driver?
qa_pairs.output: In the Delimited Text driver, you would set up one-way synchronization when your data synchronization needs to go only in one direction—either from the identity vault to the connected system (Publisher channel only) or from the connected system to the identity vault (Subscriber channel only). This requires disabling the channel that you don't use by clearing its filters and removing the associated file path configuration.

qa_pairs.instruction: How do you configure one-way synchronization using only the Publisher channel in the Delimited Text driver?
qa_pairs.output:
To configure the Delimited Text driver for Publisher-only synchronization:

1. In the Filter editor in Identity Console, clear the filters on the Subscriber channel:
   a. Select the object class (for example, the User class)
   b. Select 'Ignore' in the Subscribe section
   The Subscriber channel icon for the class changes to show that the class is no longer being synchronized.

2. Click Save to save the changes.

3. Edit the driver properties to remove the path specified for the Output File Path. This setting is located under the Subscriber Settings for the Driver Parameters on the Configuration tab.

qa_pairs.instruction: How do you configure one-way synchronization using only the Subscriber channel in the Delimited Text driver?
qa_pairs.output: To configure the Delimited Text driver for Subscriber-only synchronization, you need to clear the filters on the Publisher object and remove the path specified for the Input File Path in the Driver Parameters section. This disables the Publisher channel while keeping the Subscriber channel active.

qa_pairs.instruction: Which driver parameter must be cleared when disabling the Subscriber channel in the Delimited Text driver?
qa_pairs.output: When disabling the Subscriber channel in the Delimited Text driver, you must clear the Output File Path parameter. This setting is located under the Subscriber Settings for the Driver Parameters on the Configuration tab.

qa_pairs.instruction: Which driver parameter must be cleared when disabling the Publisher channel in the Delimited Text driver?
qa_pairs.output: When disabling the Publisher channel in the Delimited Text driver, you must clear the Input File Path parameter in the Driver Parameters section.

qa_pairs.instruction: What happens to the channel icon when you set a class to 'Ignore' in the Delimited Text driver?
qa_pairs.output: In the Delimited Text driver, when you select 'Ignore' in the Subscribe section for a class (such as the User class), the Subscriber channel icon for that class changes to visually indicate that the class is no longer being synchronized through the Subscriber channel.

qa_pairs.instruction: Summarize the key steps for setting up one-way synchronization in the Delimited Text driver.
qa_pairs.output: To set up one-way synchronization in the Delimited Text driver, you must disable the unused channel by: (1) clearing the filters on the channel you don't need by setting object classes to 'Ignore' in the Filter editor, and (2) removing the corresponding file path—either the Output File Path for Subscriber channel or the Input File Path for Publisher channel—from the Driver Parameters configuration. For Publisher-only synchronization, disable the Subscriber channel; for Subscriber-only synchronization, disable the Publisher channel.
